title: Cohort Activation Playbook & Cycle Roadmap for SDKs, Docs, Quickstarts
creator: Diego Ramos
description: Run a repeatable, sprint-aligned cohort program to accelerate developer activation for our SDKs, documentation, and quickstarts. This ticket creates the canonical playbook, maps the 6-week cycle cadence, and defines A/B experiments for content, sample apps, and onboarding flows. The goal is to build a low-friction activation pipeline that scales from self-serve users to sales-assisted pilots and provides signal into the product OKRs for 'time-to-first-success' and 'activated MAUs'.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical cohort playbook published in Confluence with step-by-step facilitator checklist
Three distinct cohort templates created: Self-serve SDK, Guided Quickstart, Enterprise Pilot
Run at least 3 cohorts (one of each template) and collect activation metrics and qualitative feedback
Playbook includes measurement dashboard (Looker/Grafana link) and defined OKR mappings
Handoff kit (email templates, onboarding sample code, support triage runbook) available to Solutions and Growth

metrics: Primary: Time-to-first-success (target < 30 minutes for SDK quickstart)
Primary: Cohort activation rate (target +15% relative to baseline within 2 weeks)
Secondary: 7-day retention and MAU uplift per cohort
Secondary: Conversion to paid sandbox/Dedicated trials for enterprise pilot
Signal: Qualitative NPS from cohort graduates and top 3 friction points logged
